snippet.title: Depth of Mind - Trailer
snippet.description:
Descend into the fractured psyche of a critical subject in this roguelike. Lead a team of mental operatives through surreal, shifting layers of memory. Face distorted manifestations of psychological disorders and uncover the truth hidden deep within the mind, before it collapses around you.

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3711100/Depth_of_Mind/
Itch io - https://funbanan.itch.io/depth-of-mind
